name: Octop
description: 腾讯开源的自托管多用户多智能体 AI 助手：单进程部署，内置 Web 面板、智能体管理与 IM 渠道接入。

install.detect: command -v octop >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo yes || echo no
install.notice: 初始化会创建数据库与管理员账号；如主机上已有 Octop 安装（~/.octop 目录），请先备份并手动清理该目录。

inputs.label: 管理员初始密码
inputs.placeholder: 至少 8 位，建议字母+数字

steps.name: 下载并安装 Octop（官方一键脚本）
初始化（数据库、JWT 与管理员账号）
注册 systemd 服务、清理启动限流并监听 0.0.0.0
steps.command:
octop service start 2>/dev/null || true
if [ -f "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/octop.service" ]; then S="--user"; else S=""; fi
if [ "$S" = "--user" ]; then
  D="$HOME/.config/systemd/user/octop.service.d"
  mkdir -p "$D"
  printf '[Service]\nEnvironment=OCTOP_BIND_HOST=0.0.0.0\n' | tee "$D/10-bind.conf" >/dev/null
  systemctl --user daemon-reload
elif [ -f /etc/systemd/system/octop.service ] && sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then
  sudo mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/octop.service.d
  printf '[Service]\nEnvironment=OCTOP_BIND_HOST=0.0.0.0\n' | sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/octop.service.d/10-bind.conf >/dev/null
  sudo systemctl daemon-reload
else
  echo '未找到 octop.service 且无免密 sudo，跳过 0.0.0.0 绑定配置'
fi
octop service stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
systemctl $S reset-failed octop.service 2>/dev/null || true
if command -v fuser >/dev/null 2>&1 && fuser 8088/tcp >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo '端口 8088 被残留进程占用，清理中…'
  fuser -k 8088/tcp 2>/dev/null || true
  sleep 1
fi
if ! octop service start; then
  echo '--- octop.service 最近日志 ---'
  journalctl $S -u octop -n 40 --no-pager 2>/dev/null || true
  tail -n 40 "$HOME/.octop/logs/"*.log 2>/dev/null || true
  exit 1
fi

ops.start:
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"
if [ -f "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/octop.service" ]; then S="--user"; else S=""; fi
systemctl $S reset-failed octop.service 2>/dev/null || true
octop service start
ops.restart:
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"
if [ -f "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/octop.service" ]; then S="--user"; else S=""; fi
systemctl $S reset-failed octop.service 2>/dev/null || true
octop service restart
ops.status:
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"
if [ -f "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/octop.service" ]; then S="--user"; else S=""; fi
raw=$(systemctl $S is-active octop 2>/dev/null)
health=fail
if curl -fsS -m 5 http://127.0.0.1:8088/api/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then health=ok; fi
# 健康接口优先：服务可能不以 unit 方式运行（前台/容器），健康即视为运行中
if [ "$health" = ok ] || [ "$raw" = active ]; then st=running
elif [ "$raw" = activating ]; then st=running
elif [ "$raw" = failed ]; then st=failed
else st=stopped; fi
pid=$(systemctl $S show -p MainPID --value octop 2>/dev/null)
[ "$pid" = "0" ] && pid=
if [ -z "$pid" ] && command -v pgrep >/dev/null 2>&1; then pid=$(pgrep -f "[o]ctop" | head -n1); fi
up=0; mem=0
if [ -n "$pid" ]; then
  up=$(ps -o etimes= -p "$pid" 2>/dev/null | tr -d " ")
  mem=$(ps -o rss= -p "$pid" 2>/dev/null | tr -d " ")
fi
if ss -tln 2>/dev/null | grep -q ":8088 "; then listening=yes; else listening=no; fi
echo "STATUS=$st"
echo "PID=${pid:-0}"
echo "PORT=8088"
echo "UPTIME_SEC=${up:-0}"
echo "MEM_KB=${mem:-0}"
echo "LISTENING=$listening"
echo "HEALTH=$health"
echo "VERSION=$(octop --version 2>/dev/null | head -n1)"
ops.logs:
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"
if [ -f "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/octop.service" ]; then J="--user"; else J=""; fi
journalctl $J -u octop -n {{.lines}} --no-pager 2>/dev/null || tail -n {{.lines}} $HOME/.octop/logs/*.log 2>/dev/null
ops.openPort:
S=""; sudo -n true 2>/dev/null && S="sudo -n"
p={{.port}}; if command -v firewall-cmd >/dev/null 2>&1 && firewall-cmd --state >/dev/null 2>&1; then $S firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=$p/tcp >/dev/null && $S firewall-cmd --reload >/dev/null && echo "firewalld: opened $p/tcp"; elif command -v ufw >/dev/null 2>&1; then $S ufw allow $p/tcp && echo "ufw: opened $p/tcp"; elif command -v iptables >/dev/null 2>&1; then $S iptables -C INPUT -p tcp --dport $p -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || $S iptables -I INPUT -p tcp --dport $p -j ACCEPT; echo "iptables: opened $p/tcp"; else echo '未找到 firewalld/ufw/iptables，请在云安全组手动放行'; fi
ops.update:
octop update || exit 1
if [ -f "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/octop.service" ]; then S="--user"; else S=""; fi
systemctl $S reset-failed octop.service 2>/dev/null || true
octop service restart

uninstall.name: 停止并注销用户态 systemd 服务（兼容系统态）
uninstall.command:
octop service stop 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl --user disable --now octop.service 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/octop.service"
rm -rf "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/octop.service.d"
systemctl --user daemon-reload 2>/dev/null || true
sudo -n systemctl disable --now octop.service 2>/dev/null || true
sudo -n rm -f /etc/systemd/system/octop.service 2>/dev/null || true
sudo -n rm -rf /etc/systemd/system/octop.service.d 2>/dev/null || true
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload 2>/dev/null || true

uninstall.name: 卸载程序（保留 ~/.octop 数据目录）
uninstall.command: command -v pipx >/dev/null 2>&1 && pipx uninstall octop 2>/dev/null || pip uninstall -y octop 2>/dev/null || true
